description: This file contains test routines written in shell script for checking protocol disabling in Git. It includes functions for testing clone, fetch, and push commands with different protocol configurations and environment variables.

methods.name: test_allow_var
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, and push with GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL environment variable set to specific protocols or 'none'.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, and push with protocol.allow configuration and environment variables, including user allow settings.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Runs combined tests for a given protocol using test_allow_var and test_config functions.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a custom SSH wrapper script to simulate SSH access within tests.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a wrapper script for accessing remote repositories in a controlled testing environment.
